title: CORS reflects any origin together with credentials

pr_metadata.title: Support mobile clients
pr_metadata.body: Mobile webviews hit the API from arbitrary origins.

labels.defect: CORS reflects arbitrary origins with Allow-Credentials: cross-site reads of authenticated responses
labels.evidence: Reproducible: attacker page at https://evil.example fetches https://api.example.com/account with credentials:include; the server reflects Allow-Origin: https://evil.example plus Allow-Credentials: true, so the browser hands the attacker the victim's authenticated response.

adjudication.notes: Origin reflection with Allow-Credentials: cross-site reads of authenticated responses.

rights.origin: original synthetic fixture authored for this corpus (repository MIT)
rights.egress: synthetic; no real secrets, hosts, or user data
